## What lives here
The Tool Service: synthesis of tools and activities (generate, verify in a sandbox, repair, register versions) and their execution, plus MCP server management. It has no auth and relies on network isolation.

`app/main.py`, the `Dockerfile`, and `docker-compose.yml` (standalone).
